_comment: Status changes staff may make with change_request_status. The database enforces the same rules (private.request_transition_allowed and private.request_change_needs_note); tests/db/requests.test.mjs checks both agree. Approved is reached only by approve_allocation (which reserves stock in the same step) and Fulfilled only by record_fulfilment. Leaving Approved or In progress for any status other than In progress returns the reserved stock.
